loss: S1 reference MSE + S1 paired effect MSE + S2 weighted factual CGM MSE
selection: fixed final step 3000; development labels never used for fitting or checkpoint selection
s2: complete official PPO_real_rewards iterations 1-8 only; shared_replay immutable
s1_deduplication: group by observed history and reference action/target/mask; unique complete arms; reference supervised once per group
tail_definition: future minimum CGM below 70 mg/dL OR current observed CGM minus future minimum at least 30 mg/dL
partial_windows: exclude origins with fewer than 48 real future outcomes; never synthesize missing labels
future_actions: actual delivered basal U/h supplied only to response; unavailable future meal/CGM never in encoder
bg: not a model input or training target; separate evaluation outcome
